args.meaning: Front-door argv. No action option serves the crossing socket; --install and --remove are mutually exclusive. --plan only suppresses unit changes in those two modes; it is not an Alkahest dry-run.

--socket.meaning: Serve socket path; the production default requires root.

--unit-dir.meaning: Unit directory for install or remove; under root only the production directory is allowed.

--install.meaning: Write the unit then request systemd daemon-reload; does not enable or start it.

--remove.meaning: Unlink the unit if present then request systemd daemon-reload.

--plan.meaning: In unit modes return the target and commands without writing or reloading.

planned.meaning: Whether the unit operation was only planned.

commands.meaning: Commands planned or attempted after a write.

stderr.meaning: Argument diagnostics or raw serve refusal. Startup failure appends the exception text; serving has no finite success receipt.

enum: crossing daemon requires root for the production socket

error.meaning: Management, unit path, or reload refusal; these are not firstMissingSignal fields.

exceptionType.meaning: Front-door projection when an uncaught unit effect fails.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Invalid argument vector or uncaught unit failure.
